name: mygod-mcp
description: A local-first Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes a multi-source music engine to AI agents: free cloud music sources and local files. Agents can search catalogs, build and play queues, control playback (play/pause/seek/volume), shape sound with a 10-band EQ, night mode and loudness normalization, read timed lyrics and comments, browse discovery feeds and the personal FM, and scan local music. The engine runs as a single instance on the machine: a Streamable HTTP `serve` mode holds the engine lock so every connected client shares one player, while the default stdio mode is spawned per client by the MCP host.

tools.description: Report the engine: its version, each source's sign-in state and guest note, the NetEase listener's profile, and the local preference profile. Call this first. NetEase's personal feeds and the radio need its session; kuwo, migu and qq play without one — signed out, login_qr starts a NetEase sign-in.
tools.name: account_status

tools.description: QR code sign-in. action=start returns the login URL — render it as a QR code for the user to scan in the NetEase Cloud Music app — and the key to poll with; action=poll reports 800 expired / 801 waiting / 802 scanned / 803 confirmed. Poll every 2–3 seconds.

key.description: for poll: the key action=start returned

tools.name: login_qr

tools.description: Search one content source's catalog: kind song/album/artist/playlist — netease also has user and podcast. Songs carry playable, so a track that would fail to play is visible before playing begins: kuwo and qq mark VIP songs playable=false, while migu plays most tracks — VIP ones included — at 128k as a guest. offset is page-granular for kuwo, migu and qq: it rounds down to a whole page.

kind.description: song (default), album, artist or playlist — netease also has user, podcast

offset.description: results to skip, default 0 (kuwo, migu and qq round down to a whole page)

source.description: the content source: netease (default), kuwo, migu, qq or local

tools.name: search_music

tools.description: Manage the local music index — the only way the local source learns what to play. action=add registers an absolute directory and scans it for mp3/flac files now; remove drops a directory and its tracks; list reports what is registered and how many tracks each still yields; rescan walks everything again to pick up added, moved or deleted files (unchanged files skip the tag re-read). source=local searches only what this has indexed.

action.description: add (path required), remove (path required), list or rescan

path.description: absolute directory path, for add and remove

tools.name: scan_local

tools.description: One profile page. netease: artist (with hot songs, or tab=albums), album, user or playlist — the page carries its name, cover and description. The other sources: album or playlist, with their tracks; those pages name the page by id and count only.

id.description: the id, a number for netease or its text for the other sources

kind.description: artist, album, user or playlist (other sources: album, playlist)

source.description: the content source: netease (default), kuwo, migu, qq or local

tab.description: albums: an artist's albums, limit and offset apply

tools.name: get_catalog

tools.description: A track's lyrics: the timed LRC, their translation where the source has one (netease, qq), and the word-timed lyrics where NetEase and QQ have one. format lrc/translation/yrc/all (default).

source.description: the content source: netease (default), kuwo, migu, qq or local

tools.name: get_lyrics

tools.description: NetEase only. The comments of a song, podcast episode or playlist: the hot ones, plus a page of the latest.

source.description: the content source: netease (default), kuwo, migu, qq or local

thread.description: any other thread, by its NetEase name (R_SO_4_…, A_DJ_1_…, A_PL_0_…)

tools.name: get_comments

tools.description: NetEase only. One home-page card per call: kind daily_songs, recommended_playlists (login), featured, charts or recent_plays (login).

kind.description: daily_songs, recommended_playlists, featured, charts or recent_plays

source.description: the content source: netease (default), kuwo, migu, qq or local

tools.name: get_discovery

tools.description: NetEase only. A few tracks the personal FM picks: mode default (the listener's taste), familiar, explore, or heart (心动模式, from a liked song in the liked-songs playlist). Returns tracks only — queue them with play_queue, or pass radio to play_queue to play them.

song_id.description: for heart: the liked song to go from

source.description: the content source: netease (default), kuwo, migu, qq or local

start_id.description: for heart: the song the mode began with, or song_id

tools.name: get_radio

tools.description: NetEase only. Write: tell the personal FM never to play a track again (trash it). A write with an effect on what the FM later picks.

source.description: the content source: netease (default), kuwo, migu, qq or local

tools.name: fm_feedback

tools.description: The player snapshot: what plays now with its current lyric line, where it is, the queue and its radio, volume, shuffle, repeat, and the dsp state (eq, night, normalize — how the sound comes out shaped). The position moves on its own between calls — call again for a fresh one.
tools.name: player_state

tools.description: Build a queue and play it: explicit track ids, a whole playlist or album, or — netease only — a radio mode (default/familiar/explore/heart). Exactly one of those, except that heart also takes song_id and playlist_id (the liked-songs playlist). source picks the catalog: netease (default), kuwo, migu or qq. kuwo, migu and qq need no sign-in. Answers with the snapshot; playing needs an audio output on this machine.

album_id.description: queue a whole album (every source serves these)

playlist_id.description: queue a whole playlist (every source serves these)

song_id.description: for radio heart: the liked song to go from

source.description: the content source: netease (default), kuwo, migu, qq or local

start.description: which queue entry to start from, 0-based

start_id.description: for radio heart: the song the mode began with, or song_id

tracks.description: track ids to queue, in order (search_music finds them; check playable first)

tools.name: play_queue

tools.description: Operations on the player, applied in order, all or nothing, answered with the snapshot after the last: toggle, play, pause, next, prev, jump (value: queue index), seek (value: seconds), volume (value: 0-1), preamp (value: gain ahead of the EQ, -12 to 12 dB), shuffle (on), repeat (mode: off/all/one), normalize (on: even out the loudness of tracks), eq (mode: a built-in preset — player_state's dsp.eqKeys lists the keys, flat is off, the values are NetEase Cloud Music's own — or a name saved with save_eq, which shadows built-ins by name, or bands: ten gains of -12 to 12 dB, 31 Hz through 16 kHz), night (on: the compression that keeps quiet parts audible), enhance (low/high, each -12 to 12 dB: the bass shelf under 120 Hz and the treble shelf above 8 kHz, what the op leaves out stays), radio_exit (leave the radio, keep the song).

bands.description: for eq without mode: ten gains, -12 to 12 dB, for 31/62/125/250/500 Hz and 1/2/4/8/16 kHz

high.description: for enhance: the treble shelf, -12 to 12 dB

low.description: for enhance: the bass shelf, -12 to 12 dB

mode.description: for repeat: off, all or one; for eq: a preset key or a name saved with save_eq

on.description: for shuffle, normalize and night: true to turn on, false to turn off

op.description: toggle, play, pause, next, prev, jump, seek, volume, preamp, shuffle, repeat, normalize, eq, night, enhance or radio_exit

value.description: for jump the queue index, for seek seconds, for volume 0 to 1

tools.name: player_control

tools.description: Save one of the listener's own EQ presets: name (saving an existing name replaces it; the name shadows a built-in preset of the same name when applied), ten gains of -12 to 12 dB for 31 Hz through 16 kHz, optional label shown on the snapshot. Presets survive restarts; apply one with player_control eq mode.

gains.description: ten gains, -12 to 12 dB, bands in order 31/63/125/250/500/1k/2k/4k/8k/16k

name.description: the preset's name; saving an existing one replaces it

tools.name: save_eq

tools.description: Delete one of the listener's own EQ presets by name. Deleting one that shadowed a built-in preset falls back to the built-in. Does not change what currently plays.

name.description: the user preset's name (player_state's dsp.userEqPresets lists them)

tools.name: delete_eq

tools.description: Not available yet (phase 3). Will compile a scene description (专注写代码, 雨天睡前) into a queue from the local preference profile.
tools.name: set_scene

tools.description: Not available yet (phase 3). Will like or unlike a track and feed the local preference profile.

like.description: true to like, false to unlike (default true)

tools.name: like_song

tools.description: Not available yet (phase 3). Will create/rename/delete (confirm required) playlists, add or remove tracks, as an operations array.
tools.name: manage_playlist

tools.description: Not available yet (phase 3). Will follow artists, subscribe podcasts, like programs — one op each, bool to reverse.
tools.name: manage_subscription
